full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white comic illustration assembles several fantasy characters into a crowded, dynamic pencil composition. The page has no broad colored background; lightly sketched foliage, rough stone, and overlapping shapes fill almost every area. In the front left, a broad-brimmed hat shades the eyes of a crouching man. He bends low with one hand reaching toward the ground, while the other grips a long straight staff or blade that runs horizontally across the middle of the picture. Creased sleeves, a vest-like torso, bent trousers, and planted boots give his pose weight. Behind him on the far left looms a large stern face, heavily shaded around the eyes and mouth. At the upper center, a pale-haired figure turns the face upward and away, with flowing hair and a high collar or wrapped neck. On the right, another feminine figure wears a high wrapped headdress and close-fitting outfit, shown from the upper body with her gaze directed toward the viewer. Thin vines, irregular branches, and sketchy foliage slip between the figures, making them appear part of a shared scene rather than separate portraits. The drawing is made from confident contour lines, dense crosshatching, and lighter construction strokes still visible beneath the finished areas. Darkest pencil values gather under the hat, within cloth folds, and behind the faces; broad white paper remains on exposed skin and upper forms. Illumination is suggested by those preserved pale planes rather than a detailed light source. No readable lettering appears. The overall composition is dense and restless, using a low diagonal action and layered faces to create narrative energy without color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白漫画插画将数名奇幻人物拼成拥挤而动感的铅笔构图。纸面没有宽阔的彩色背景；轻轻勾出的叶丛、粗石和相叠形状几乎填满每个区域。左前方，宽檐帽遮住一名蹲伏男子的眼睛。他压低身体，一只手伸向地面，另一只握着一根笔直的长杖或刀刃，横穿画面中部。起皱的袖子、背心般的躯干、弯曲裤腿和踏实的靴子让姿势有重量。左后方高处，一张巨大的严厉面孔压下来，眼周和嘴边被浓重排线包围。上方中央，一名浅发人物仰脸转向别处，头发飘动，颈部有高领或包裹的衣物。右侧另一名女性形象戴着高高缠绕的头饰，穿贴身服装，以半身姿态望向观者。细藤、不规则树枝和草图般叶丛从人物之间穿过，让他们显得处在同一场景而非分开的肖像中。画面由自信的轮廓线、密集交叉排线和仍可在完成区域下方看见的较浅辅助线构成。最深的铅笔明度聚在帽檐下、衣褶中和面容后方；露出的皮肤及上部形态保留大面积白纸。照明靠这些被保留的浅亮平面暗示，没有细致描绘光源。画中没有可读字样。整体构图密集而不安定，以低伏的斜向动作和层叠面孔创造无色彩的叙事活力。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome comic drawing uses crisp contour lines, dense crosshatching, and visible pale construction marks on off-white paper. Values range from untouched white to deep graphite black, with high contrast concentrated at overlaps and narrow recesses. The central mass is crowded and layered, yet each major silhouette is clarified by selective light gaps and changes in line weight. Diagonal strokes and long horizontal accents drive the eye through the composition. Fine descriptive textures accumulate in small zones, while broader pale planes give the dense marks room to breathe. Lighting is expressed through preserved paper and hatching density rather than smooth tonal blending or cast shadows. The overall effect is energetic and unfinished in a productive way, combining polished focal passages with the urgency of an exploratory drawing.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色漫画绘画在灰白纸面上使用清晰轮廓线、密集交叉排线和可见的浅辅助线。明度从未经着笔的白纸到深石墨黑，强对比集中在重叠处和狭窄凹处。中央色团拥挤而分层，主要剪影仍靠有选择的亮隙与线重变化获得清晰度。斜向笔划和长水平重音带领视线穿过构图。细描述性纹理聚在小区域，较宽的浅亮平面则给密集痕迹留出呼吸空间。光照通过保留纸白和排线密度表达，而非平滑明暗混合或投影。整体效果有活力，且带有富于成果的未完成感，把打磨过的焦点区域与探索性草图的急迫感结合。
theme_en: An adventurous figure crouching before layered fantasy characters in a pencil sketch
theme_zh: 铅笔草图中冒险者蹲伏在层叠的奇幻角色前
name: Bill Willingham
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
